name: pet-toy-shop-api
description: NestJS backend for a domestic pet toy independent shop.

scripts.ops:drill:cloud-pet-cold-start: cross-env CLOUD_PET_RELEASE_ID=cloud-pet-cold-start-drill npm run build && cross-env CLOUD_PET_RELEASE_ID=cloud-pet-cold-start-drill node scripts/cloud-pet-cold-start-handover-drill.mjs
scripts.ops:drill:cloud-pet-warm-restart: cross-env CLOUD_PET_RELEASE_ID=cloud-pet-warm-restart-drill npm run build && cross-env CLOUD_PET_RELEASE_ID=cloud-pet-warm-restart-drill node scripts/cloud-pet-warm-restart-handover-drill.mjs
scripts.ops:check:cloud-pet-sqlite-single-instan: cross-env CLOUD_PET_RELEASE_ID=cloud-pet-sqlite-single-instance-smoke npm run build && cross-env CLOUD_PET_RELEASE_ID=cloud-pet-sqlite-single-instance-smoke node scripts/cloud-pet-sqlite-single-instance-smoke.mjs
scripts.smoke:production: cross-env CLOUD_PET_RELEASE_ID=production-smoke-release npm run build && cross-env CLOUD_PET_RELEASE_ID=production-smoke-release npm run web:build && cross-env CLOUD_PET_RELEASE_ID=production-smoke-release node scripts/production-smoke.mjs
scripts.smoke:cloud-pet-prisma: cross-env CLOUD_PET_RELEASE_ID=cloud-pet-prisma-smoke-release npm run build && cross-env CLOUD_PET_RELEASE_ID=cloud-pet-prisma-smoke-release ts-node scripts/cloud-pet-prisma-smoke.ts
scripts.smoke:cloud-pet-ops-config-prisma: cross-env CLOUD_PET_RELEASE_ID=cloud-pet-ops-config-smoke-release npm run build && cross-env CLOUD_PET_RELEASE_ID=cloud-pet-ops-config-smoke-release ts-node scripts/cloud-pet-ops-config-prisma-smoke.ts
scripts.smoke:cloud-pet-web-production: cross-env CLOUD_PET_RELEASE_ID=production-smoke-release npm run build && cross-env CLOUD_PET_RELEASE_ID=production-smoke-release node scripts/cloud-pet-web-production-smoke.mjs
scripts.api:dev:memory: cross-env NODE_ENV=test KZT_USE_MEMORY_STORE=true DATABASE_URL= ts-node src/main.ts
